reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `updaterequests.kyverno.io` changes v1beta1 → v2", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, run a storage version migration for updaterequests.kyverno.io (re-write all UpdateRequest objects at the new storage version) and update the CRD's status.storedVersions before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the updaterequests.kyverno.io CRD changed from v1beta1 to v2 (v1beta1.storage true→false, v2.storage false→true between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0), so existing UpdateRequest objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update is required before a later release removes v1beta1.
